observations: free checks the current cache size before recycling an entire buffer, so a positive cache limit can be exceeded by the freed buffer.
malloc trims free cache above the configured limit after allocation or reuse.
set_cache_limit changes the threshold without clearing existing buffers.
active peak excludes inactive cached buffers.
Zero cache with an initial clear disables subsequent buffer caching, but the native attention operator rejects this setting on latency.
The candidate retains the original 2258155644-byte overshoot allowance; no smaller largest-free-buffer bound is claimed.
